items.name: PrimitiveRunBuilder

methods.name: append_null
methods.summary: Appends null to the logical array encoded by the run-ends array.

methods.name: append_option
methods.summary: Appends optional value to the logical array encoded by the RunArray.

methods.name: append_value
methods.summary: Appends value to the logical array encoded by the run-ends array.

methods.summary: Returns the builder as a non-mutable `Any` reference.

methods.summary: Returns the builder as a mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<T: IntoIterator<Item = Option<V::Native>>>(&mut self, iter: T)

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Creates the RunArray and resets the builder. Panics if RunArray cannot be built.

methods.summary: Builds the array and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Creates the RunArray and without resetting the builder. Panics if RunArray cannot be built.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the array without resetting the builder.

methods.name: into_box_any
methods.summary: Returns the boxed builder as a box of `Any`.

methods.summary: Returns the length of logical array encoded by the eventual runs array.
